description: Test suite for the EventBus implementation, covering subscription, unsubscription, publishing, concurrency, and custom types.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Subscribe
methods.description: Tests subscribing a single subscriber to the event bus.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Subscribe_Multiple
methods.description: Tests subscribing multiple subscribers and verifying the count.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Unsubscribe
methods.description: Tests unsubscribing a subscriber and ensuring the channel is closed.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Unsubscribe_NotSubscribed
methods.description: Tests unsubscribing a non-existent subscriber does not panic.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_SingleSubscriber
methods.description: Tests publishing an event to a single subscriber.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_MultipleSubscribers
methods.description: Tests publishing an event to multiple subscribers.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_NoSubscribers
methods.description: Tests publishing with no subscribers does not panic.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Publish_AfterUnsubscribe
methods.description: Tests that unsubscribed channels do not receive events and are closed.

methods.name: TestEventBus_SubscriberCount
methods.description: Verifies subscriber count updates correctly after subscribe/unsubscribe.

methods.name: TestEventBus_ConcurrentSubscribeUnsubscribePublish
methods.description: Tests concurrent subscribe and unsubscribe operations.

methods.name: TestEventBus_SlowSubscriber
methods.description: Verifies that slow subscribers do not block the publisher.

methods.name: TestEventBus_CustomType
methods.description: Tests publishing and receiving custom struct events.

methods.name: TestEventBus_EventOrdering
methods.description: Verifies that events are received in the order they were published.

methods.name: TestEventBus_Resubscribe
methods.description: Tests resubscribing after unsubscribe and ensures new channel is created.
